name: Feature 3DGS Rendering
definition: A method to render high-dimensional semantic feature maps alongside RGB images using 3D Gaussians, enabling distillation from 2D foundation models via differentiable volumetric rendering.
summary: Feature 3DGS Rendering jointly rasterizes RGB and semantic feature maps using explicit 3D Gaussians, avoiding the interference and hyperparameter sensitivity inherent in implicit NeRF-based methods.
